options.name: auth_token
options.description: automatics authentication bearer token returned from automatics_login module

options.name: component_ids
options.description: components in automatics to select for the operation (id matching) must match the automatics component-id

options.name: components
options.description: components in automatics to select for the operation (name matching) dict with 'type', 'name, 'instance_number' and 'client' that must match the automatics component-type, name, instance-id and client

options.name: execution_timeout
options.description: Execution timeout in minutes for the triggered executions in automatics

options.name: node_ids
options.description: nodes in automatics to select for the operation (id matching) must match the automatics node-id

options.name: nodes
options.description: nodes in automatics to select for the operation (name/hostname matching) dict containing 'name' and 'client' that must match the automatics name and client

options.name: parameters
options.description: automatics parameters for executiong a workflow the following parameters should not be used here: 'ClientID', 'SystemID', 'ComponentID', 'NodeID'. These are automatically generated based on the system(_id), component(_id) or node(_id) selection.

options.name: system_ids
options.description: systems in automatics to select for the operation (id matching) must match the automatics system-id

options.name: systems
options.description: systems in automatics to select for the operation (name matching) dict containing 'type', 'name' and 'client' that must match the automatics system-type, name and client for systems of type 'sap' and 'sap-hana-db', the 'name' equals the SAP SID for systems of type 'sap-wdp', the 'name' equals <sapsid>@<node>

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Verify the https certificate of the automatics server.

options.name: workflow
options.description: workflow in automatics to select for the operation (name matching)

options.name: workflow_id
options.description: workflow in automatics to select for the operation (id matching)
